file: POV - EVERYONE SAID NO UNTIL SHE SAID YES - V1.mp4
title:
POV: EVERYONE SAID NO
UNTIL SHE SAID YES 🇮🇱
people: Israeli woman in a campus parking lot who drove Tal to Tel Aviv (gives private lessons in law); 2 refusals as setup
hook: Why did you say yes? — Why not? ... Everyone told me no, and you told me yes. — Lucky! I was in a good mood.
note: Hebrew captions machine-translated — Tal to check wording. I re-translated every Hebrew line by hand from a fresh Hebrew transcript instead of using the Groq machine English (which had 'trip/tramp' for tremp, 'in legal/police' for law, 'you touched my hair'). Still Tal-check: 'I am.' (her yes, 2892 @17s) could not be confirmed from the Hebrew transcript; 'Kind people in this world, really' / 'People only see things and think everyone only thinks of themselves' (the machine version said 'on Instagram', not in my Hebrew transcript, so left out). It opens on the car Q&A (her face) because the refusals and the parking-lot yes have no visible faces; refusals shown: 'No, I take the bus' and 'No chance' (distant, nobody identifiable). Cut: the money-refusal clip 2776 (camera points at the car ceiling), the Ferrari joke, Tal's outro, 'Gila' (possible name).
